About us
How can we help you?
We believe that we work best when we work together with customers, towards shared goals and mutually beneficial outcomes.
WHAT’S MOST IMPORTANT
Our values state what is most important in, and for, this company. They convey those things that are of fundamental importance, upon which everything of consequence is based. By their nature, they are unequivocal, non-negotiable, enduring and are constants over time and distance.
Think Long Term
Look beyond the horizon. Make decisions in the best interests of the next generation. We want short-term and long-term success. Actions and decisions should stand the test of time.
We Care about People
Everyone matters. We care about people as individuals. We strive to make sure everyone is safe and healthy. We care about employees’ physical, mental, emotional and spiritual wellness.
Do the Right Thing
Unequivocal and uncompromising. Be courageous. Be an example. Honesty and integrity are the foundation of our reputation.
Honor Commitments
Keep our word. Always deliver, no excuses. Be reliable and trustworthy.
The Power of “We”
We believe in collaboration and teamwork. Diverse views. Our collective results are more important than individual accomplishments.
Openness and Transparency
Truth. No hidden agenda or ulterior motives. Listen first. We are who we say we are.
Make a Positive Impact
Strengthen all parties and relationships. Act with purpose. We care about others’ success. We “leave it better than we found it”, everywhere, every time
"EVERYTHING MATTERS MORE" VIDEO
"BUILDING TOMORROW TOGETHER" VIDEO
OUR APPROACH TO BUSINESS
Zachry Group is North America's pacesetter in turnkey engineering, construction, maintenance, turnaround and fabrication services to the energy, chemicals, power, manufacturing and industrial sectors.
We work with customers to plan, build and renew their most critical facilities, so they can achieve their immediate and long-term goals, all at the highest safety standards.
To achieve these outcomes, we have developed a way of doing business that is based around four principles:
Focus on Distinctive Value
We are always looking for ways to deliver distinctive value to our customers. This applies to their immediate priorities, but also to unlocking their long term opportunities, using the freedom that our structure provides to focus on value beyond the immediate bottom line.
Priority on Customer Success
We recognize that customer success is the basis for our success. We work with our customers to truly understand their goals so we can address issues early and respond quickly to opportunities to enhance their business outcomes.
Right Team in the Right Place
We’ve invested heavily in creating an extraordinary craft, professional and support workforce. We continue to invest in their training and development, to keep their skillset on the leading edge, and equip them to fulfill their potential as individuals and members of a team.
Adaptive Excellence in Execution
Every assignment contains unique challenges. Our self-perform execution model and long-tenured teams enable us to recognize and respond to these challenges and deliver outstanding execution safely under any condition.
